// @molis-ai/molis-work-contracts: public API snapshot.
// Generated by `node scripts/gates/api-snapshot.mjs --update`; do not edit by hand. A change below is a change to what plugins and other callers can use:
// say what it means for them in the PR.

export interface ContractDescriptor {
    readonly contractId: string;
    readonly kind: "module" | "service" | "platform";
    readonly schemaVersion: number;
    readonly maturity: ContractMaturity;
    readonly ssot: string;
}

export type ContractMaturity = "contract-only" | "partial" | "implemented";
